messages:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT — cluster-prod/node-gnode-17 reporting EPHEMERAL_DISK_PRESSURE, multiple pods evicted. Auto-pager to on-call.

alice (oncall): I see the page. jumping in. what's the impact?

bob (infra): kubelet eviction triggered. imagefs.available is <4% on node-gnode-17. Evicted ~18 pods, some are runtime/modelcache pods.

carol (runtime): confirmed: several runtime pods crashed during model load. logs show model cache write errors then crash: `RuntimeError: failed to persist KV cache: ENOSPC` and then CUDA failures when restart attempted: `CUDA error: out of memory`.

alice (oncall): ok — immediate mitigation plan: cordon + drain node to stop further evictions, free disk on node, restart runtime pods on other nodes, scale down prefetching. dave, bob — can you cordon now?

bob (infra): cordoning node now -> `kubectl cordon node-gnode-17` :done:. Starting drain (will force evict remaining pods that didn't already terminate).

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T18:22:17 -> blocked on node-gnode-17 under pressure.

alice (oncall): dave, can you run df/du to see what's filling up? might be modelcache, logs, or tmp.

dave (sre): running quick checks:
```
# ssh node-gnode-17
$ df -h /var/lib
Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/nvme0n1p2  200G  198G  1.2G  99% /var/lib
$ du -sh /var/lib/modelcache
85G\t/var/lib/modelcache
$ du -sh /var/log/journal
42G\t/var/log/journal
```

dave (sre): modelcache + persistent journal fill nearly everything. logs show aggressive model prefetching + large rollback dumps from a previous failed load.

carol (runtime): that matches runtime telemetry — model prefetcher spawned too many concurrent downloads after the last rollout, cache retention policy didn't evict old quantized checkpoints.

alice (oncall): immediate actions: 1) free some space to stop kubelet thrash 2) restart a subset of runtime pods on other nodes 3) disable prefetch until we fix retention.

bob (infra): freeing space: removing old journal files and truncated crash dumps.
```
$ journalctl --vacuum-size=2G
# removed ~30G
$ rm -rf /var/lib/modelcache/preload-temp/*
# reclaimed ~40G
```

bob (infra): reclaimed ~72G total, node free now ~70G available. kubelet eviction should stop.

carol (runtime): I'm pausing prefetch on the hot service with the flag `--prefetch=0` and redeploying pods to pick new config. will also push a temporary modelcache size cap.

erin (eng): pushing canary config to disable prefetch: `kubectl set env deploy/runtime-service PREFETCH_LIMIT=0 --namespace=prod` -> applied to 3 pods.

carol (runtime): restarting runtime pods that crashed. logs show model loads now succeed but initial latency spikes for cold-started cache. No more ENOSPC. CUDA OOMs reduced as some models weren't loading now.

alice (oncall): customer impact check: any 5xx rates or errors reported?

dave (sre): Grafana: a 5xx spike between 18:19–18:34 for the us-west mesh. ~1.2k failed requests, ~12 distinct customer tokens affected, endpoints /v1/generate and /v1/chat/completions. Error signature: `MODEL_LOAD_FAILURE` then fallback -> 502.

carol (runtime): we served fallbacks for some traffic to smaller model variant, but a subset saw 502s while pods restarted.

alice (oncall): update on-call escalation: Erin, can you own customer comms triage with CS? Give rough ETA and impacted customers list.

erin (eng): on it — pulling recent logs & request traces, will coordinate with CS to message top affected customers. ETA 30m for a preliminary list.

bob (infra): node remains cordoned. Starting cautious uncordon after one last health check once all pods stable.

carol (runtime): telemetry shows modelcache eviction policy misaligned with disk size. We need a permanent fix: change retention to LRU with disk-aware threshold and add disk-pressure alert smarter than current absolute % (consider reserved bytes). Filing follow-up ticket.

alice (oncall): short-term runbook items done: cordon+drain, reclaimed disk, paused prefetch, restarted pods, monitoring. Next: postmortem, config change, and a backout guard on prefetch rollouts.

dave (sre): I'm leaving a sticky snippet for next on-call:
```
# quick checks
kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep gnode-17
kubectl describe node node-gnode-17 | egrep -i "Pressure|Evicted"
ssh node-gnode-17 'df -h /var/lib; du -sh /var/lib/modelcache/* | sort -h | tail -n 20'
journalctl --disk-usage
```

alice (oncall): handing off to erin (next on-call) for customer impact follow-up and monitoring. Handoff summary: disk pressure caused by modelcache + journal causing kubelet evictions; mitigated by reclaiming ~72G, cordon+drain, paused prefetch, restarted pods. System now stable and serving traffic; watch 5xxs for next 2 hours.

erin (eng): acknowledged. I'll pair with CS and put an incident banner for affected customers.

deploy-bot: automated note — previously scheduled deploys targeting runtime-service were paused during incident.

carol (runtime): assigning follow-up: OPT-3542 (modify modelcache retention + prefetch limits), OPT-3543 (add disk-reserved bytes alert), and POSTMORTEM-2026-03-15. I'll own OPT-3542.

alice (oncall): incident status -> MITIGATED. continuing to monitor. Postmortem owner = carol. Customer-impact summary to follow from erin/CS. Great teamwork, thanks. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to MITIGATED at 18:41:28. Monitoring period started (2h). Postmortem workflow created.
